campaignProposal.description: Rafii sends one-time SMS verification codes to authenticated users who request verification of their own phone number in their Rafii account. A verified number is required for user-consented assistant phone calls. This SMS program is limited to requested verification codes.
campaignProposal.messageFlow: Proposed consent screen: an authenticated user opens Rafii phone settings, enters a phone number with its country code, reads the SMS program notice and links to its privacy policy and terms, and clicks Send verification code to request one verification text. The notice names Rafii, explains that message and data rates may apply, and gives STOP opt-out instructions. This notice and the STOP handling must be implemented and deployed before this description is filed.
samples: Your Rafii verification code is 123456. It expires in 10 minutes. Do not share it. Reply STOP to opt out.
